title: Welder Salary in Canada (2026): Hourly Pay by Province
excerpt: The median welder salary in Canada is $30 an hour, but Alberta pays $38 and Ontario $28. Here is the Job Bank wage data by province and what moves a welder's pay up.
seoTitle: Welder Salary in Canada 2026: Pay by Province
seoDesc: Welder salary in Canada by province: Job Bank median $30/hr, Alberta $38, Ontario $28. See low/high ranges and what raises welder pay in 2026.
